data.title: BIN Enumeration Sequential Card Number Attack
data.description: Detects sequential or near-sequential card number authorization attempts sharing the same Bank Identification Number (BIN) prefix with incremental variation in the remaining digits. BIN enumeration attacks generate valid card numbers by iterating through possible combinations within a BIN range, validating each against live payment infrastructure through sub-dollar authorization requests. Sequential card numbers from the same BIN prefix have a zero false positive rate for legitimate merchants — this pattern is exclusively associated with fraudulent enumeration. Recorded Future's 2025 report documents BIN attacks as a primary method for generating valid card credentials for downstream fraud, with enumerated cards feeding into card testing (TP-0038), digital wallet provisioning (TP-0037), and card-not-present fraud operations. This rule targets Phase 4 of TP-0038.

detection.condition: selection and aggregation_bin and filter_sequential and filter_decline

enrichment_required.source: Payment analytics enrichment (decline rate calculation over window)

falsepositives: Corporate card programs where cards are issued with sequential numbers to the same organization (extremely rare in authorization streams)
